description.zh:
端口列表 ID。

>如果当前端口列表已关联其他资源，则无法删除，需解除关联后删除。
description.en:
The ID of the port list.

> If the port list is associated with other resources, you cannot delete the port list. You must disassociate the port list from the resources and then delete the port list.

description.zh: 端口列表所在地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the port list. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-port-range-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --port-range-list-id prl-2ze97430000 --region cn-hangzhou
